headline: S&P and Deutsche Bank Downgrade Philippines Economic Growth Forecasts
summary: S&P Global Ratings and Deutsche Bank lowered their economic growth forecasts for the Philippines, pointing to sluggish public capital expenditure and governance issues.
why: Lower sovereign growth estimates influence foreign direct investment appetite and Philippine central bank policy easing expectations.

impacts.name: Philippines
impacts.why: S&P and Deutsche Bank downgraded GDP growth outlooks due to weak public spending.
